item.title: Marvel Renews ‘Wonder Man’ For Season 2 At Disney+
item.description: For a while there, “Wonder Man” felt like the kind of Marvel project that might vanish into the company’s infamous TV recalibration — a weird side road too odd to survive the franchise’s belt-tightening, with rumors floating that the show had been scrapped. Instead, it’s coming back. Marvel has renewed “Wonder Man” for a second season at Disney+, with Yahya Abdul-Mateen II returning as Simon Williams and Ben Kingsley back as Trevor Slattery. item.description: The streets in Brad Ingelsby country were never going to stay quiet for long.
